SR. BR. REV.
No. N. 925
June 190, 20/6... 6/ ...

Radio Materials in Standard Radio Corporation
Godown Removed by Japanese

At about 1 a.m. June 19, a number of Japanese
Gendarmes, accompanied by officers of the French Police,
proceeded to the godown of the Standard Radio Corporation
(標準無線電公司) at Lane 142/9 Rue du Lieut. Petiot,
French Concession, and took away all radio materials in
the premises. The watchman of the godown was also
arrested.

D.C. (C. & S.O3)

标准无线电公司仓库内的无线电材料被日本人搬走

6月19日凌晨1时许，数名日本宪兵在法国巡捕房警官的陪同下，前往位于法租界佩蒂奥中尉路（Rue du Lieut. Petiot）142弄9号的标准无线电公司（標準無線電公司）仓库，将屋内所有无线电材料搬走。该仓库看守人亦被捕。
